items.html: *And we shall now explain them in more detail. Know that, as stated above, in the fetus itself there are three aspects, which correspond to pregnancy, nursing, and the Mochin of Gadlut. And there are in it many gradations: the three days of absorption, and forty days, and the first three months, and the nine months of pregnancy. And likewise, in this manner, it was also explained how in Gadlut there are many gradations: the age of Peotot, and the age of a boy of nine years, when his sexual contact is considered a sexual contact, and the age of a complete man, from thirteen years, and the age of eighteen for the wedding canopy, and likewise twenty for pursuing. As explained there at length, in their places. Behold, likewise in the time of nursing there are in them many gradations. For the Mochin of nursing are in the manner of the Mochin of Gadlut, which contain the Tzelem of Ima and the Tzelem of Aba, and internal and surrounding lights.
